beats: Receive the blue-reed ceramic thank-you; it is not a key.
Mother opens the stair door with her own key. Follow the cellar passage to the heavy vault door.
Mother and seller put the necklace away and recommend the museum’s sabre exhibit.
data.consequences: The keepsake can be collected after an already completed necklace quest. The visit neither awards the sabre nor starts the later heist.

description:
The seller entrusts the necklace to Mother. Ordinary maintenance supplies give way to a vault too large for the visible household, leaving a question without answering it.

Vault origin, lower-lamp purpose, Mother’s ritual and her knowledge of the blade remain unconfirmed.

sections: Section 20: implemented vault/museum; supersedes the old unimplemented vault note in 5.3

name: A place to keep it safe
